reader.requirement: END-READ must terminate the READ statement it follows (the most recently preceding unterminated READ, per §1985:IV.6.4.3), so statements after it are outside the READ's AT END / NOT AT END phrases and a READ ... END-READ can nest as an imperative statement; a stray END-READ with no open READ is refused.

edition-consulted.switches: END-READ reserved at each edition (row reserved true at 1985, 2002, 2014, 2023)

reader.notes: Scope delimiting is done by the shared ANTLR rule readStatement (conditionalPhrases END_READ?) and needs no edition arm because END-READ exists and is reserved at 1985. Nested, unconditional and implicitly terminated forms behave as §1985:IV.6.4.3 states, and a stray END-READ is refused with COBOL0306.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:IV.6.4.3 and §1985:IV.6.4.2.3.1 (a delimited scope statement is imperative; a READ with AT END/NOT AT END and no END-READ is conditional).
